
{{alias}}( y, p )
    Computes the hinge loss between two double-precision floating-point number.

    If either argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.
    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    g: number
        Hinge loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var g = {{alias}}( 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~0.218
    > g = {{alias}}( 1.0, 0.202 )
    0.798
    > g = {{alias}}( -1.0, -0.999 )
    ~0.001
    > g = {{alias}}( -1.0, 0.2 )
    1.2
    > g = {{alias}}( NaN, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
